verdict.rationale: Teller's REST API supports the core primitives (balances, transactions, identity, connect/link sessions via Teller Connect, mTLS-scoped credentials) that an agent could call, but there is no evidence of an MCP server, agent-oriented SDK, or machine-readable API spec — probes for llms.txt, docs.md, and openapi.json all returned 404, indicating no first-class AI-agent integration surface. missing for 10: an MCP server or agent tool-calling interface, machine-readable OpenAPI/llms.txt discovery, and any documentation framing agent-driven scoped access.
